levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عمر بن ميسرة

notes: «- المعنى -» is an editor gloss and is left out; the remark «قال حماد هذا أو نحوه» is a wording note, not a route
Abu Dawud's three remarks name other transmitters at Hammad's level (Bishr with Malik, Abdah, Ibn Uyayna): variant groups, not routes
The people of the story (Muhayyisa, Abd Allah ibn Sahl, Abd al-Rahman) are in the scene, not links
